description: This file implements a daemon server for managing socket connections, including platform-specific socket path normalization, socket existence checks, and server startup logic with connection handling.

classes.name: SocketConnection
classes.description: Handles individual socket connections, managing message sending and receiving, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: normalizeSocketPath
methods.description: Converts socket path to platform-specific format, handling Windows named pipes and Unix sockets.

methods.name: socketExists
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if a socket file exists and is a socket.

methods.name: startMcpDaemonServer
methods.description: Starts a server listening on a platform-specific socket or pipe, handling client connections and messages.
